title: Lawsuits Against Believers, Flee Sexual Immorality

questions.question: When one of you has a grievance against another, does he dare go to law before the unrighteous instead of the ____?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:1 (ESV): "When one of you has a grievance against another, does he dare go to law before the unrighteous instead of the saints?"

questions.question: Or do you not know that the saints will judge the ____?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:2 (ESV): "Or do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is to be judged by you, are you incompetent to try trivial cases?"

questions.question: Paul asks another rhetorical question: "Do you not know that we are to judge ____?"
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:3 (ESV): "Do you not know that we are to judge angels? How much more, then, matters pertaining to this life!"

questions.question: To have lawsuits at all with one another is already a ____ for you.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:7 (ESV): "To have lawsuits at all with one another is already a defeat for you. Why not rather suffer wrong? Why not rather be defrauded?"

questions.question: Why not rather suffer ____? Why not rather be defrauded?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:7 (ESV): "Why not rather suffer wrong? Why not rather be defrauded?"

questions.question: Or do you not know that the unrighteous will not inherit the ____?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:9 (ESV): "Or do you not know that the unrighteous will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived..."

questions.question: Paul lists those who will not inherit the kingdom of God. Which of these is NOT in his list in verses 9-10?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:9-10 (ESV) lists the sexually immoral, idolaters, adulterers, men who practice homosexuality, thieves, the greedy, drunkards, revilers, and swindlers. Murderers are not explicitly mentioned in this list.

questions.question: And such were some of you. But you were washed, you were ____, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:11 (ESV): "And such were some of you. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God."

questions.question: "All things are lawful for me," but not all things are ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:12 (ESV): "'All things are lawful for me,' but not all things are helpful. 'All things are lawful for me,' but I will not be dominated by anything."

questions.question: "All things are lawful for me," but I will not be ____ by anything.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:12 (ESV): "'All things are lawful for me,' but I will not be dominated by anything."

questions.question: "Food is meant for the stomach and the stomach for food"—and God will destroy both one and the other. The body is not meant for sexual immorality, but for ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:13 (ESV): "...The body is not meant for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body."

questions.question: Do you not know that he who is joined to a prostitute becomes ____ with her? For, as it is written, "The two will become one flesh."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:16 (ESV): "Or do you not know that he who is joined to a prostitute becomes one body with her? For, as it is written, 'The two will become one flesh.'"

questions.question: But he who is joined to the Lord becomes one ____ with him.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:17 (ESV): "But he who is joined to the Lord becomes one spirit with him."

questions.question: What is the command Paul gives regarding sexual immorality in verse 18? Every other sin a person commits is outside the body, but the sexually immoral person sins against his own body.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:18 (ESV): "Flee from sexual immorality. Every other sin a person commits is outside the body, but the sexually immoral person sins against his own body."

questions.question: Or do you not know that your body is a ____ of the Holy Spirit within you, whom you have from God?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:19 (ESV): "Or do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit within you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,"

key_verse_text: Or do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit within you, whom you have from God? You are not your own, for you were bought with a price. So glorify God in your body.
